label: Python — boto3
code:
import boto3

s3 = boto3.client(
    's3',
    endpoint_url='<RESOURCE_HOST>',
    region_name='eu-west-1',
    aws_access_key_id='<AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID>',
    aws_secret_access_key='<AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY>'
)

response = s3.list_objects_v2(Bucket='media-assets')
print(response.get('Contents', []))
